subject: Capacity blueprint workshop: dedicated pools & isolation — coordination
messages:
From: Aisha Mehra <aisha@finedge.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: dedicated GPU capacity architecture review (FinEdge)

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The FinEdge infra team would like a focused architecture deep-dive on dedicated capacity: pool sizing, autoscaling behavior under burst, and isolation/failover patterns.

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute session the week of Sep 20? Our goal is to validate sizing assumptions for a pilot and outline a fallback/degenerate plan for our existing shared endpoints.

Attendees from our side: Aisha Mehra (PM), Benjamin Lee (platform eng). I'll loop procurement if we start contract conversations.

Attached: a short spreadsheet with our baseline QPS + token estimates (finedge_workload_qps.csv).

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Mehra
Senior Product Manager, FinEdge Systems
[Attachment: finedge_workload_qps.csv (CSV, 12 KB)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Mehra <aisha@finedge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: dedicated GPU capacity architecture review (FinEdge)

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the context and the QPS snapshot — that's perfect prework. We can run a 90-minute workshop that covers:
- pool sizing & buffer targets (steady vs peak)
- autoscale policies (scale-in/out thresholds, cooldowns, warm vs cold starts)
- isolation strategies (tenant isolation, eviction/fallback, quota guardrails)
- measured runbook & test plan for fault injection

Proposed slots:
- Thu Sep 23, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Tue Sep 21, 14:00–15:30 PT

Could you confirm who from engineering will join (Benjamin or another)? Also helpful: a short sample of token-length percentiles (p50/p95) if you have them.

I'll attach a one‑page agenda and a short prework checklist. Marissa will lead the technical walkthrough. Karthik will join to capture the mutual action plan and procurement triggers.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: agenda_capacity_deepdive.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-14T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: dedicated GPU capacity architecture review (FinEdge)

Rachel / Aisha —

90 minutes sounds right. For the tech portion I'll prepare:
- a sizing model spreadsheet with steady-state vs 99th-percentile buckets
- recommended autoscale policies (example YAML snippets)
- isolation matrix showing how reserved pools + soft-eviction interact with cache/KV state
Quick asks for the session to be productive:
1) Attach real traffic percentiles if possible (token lengths and request interarrival).
2) Confirm whether you want a sandbox run (we can run a small injection test but need 48 hrs to provision).
3) Any NDAs or security constraints for a live run?

If Aisha confirms a sandbox run we should add Mina to the invite (she'll own the runbook & test harness).

-Marissa
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

Hi Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks — we can do Sep 23, 10:00–11:30 PT. Benjamin will be the technical lead. Looping procurement for awareness (procurement@finedge.com).

We can share p50/p95 token counts and a small sample of request traces — attaching a CSV. We would like to include a short conversation around an "isolation test kit" you mentioned during the demo: what does that entail (duration, data requirements)?

Aisha —

Sep 23 works for us. We'll prepare a mutual action plan (MAP) during the meeting to align pilot milestones, deliverables, and procurement checkpoints. High-level items I'll own:
- timeline for reserved pool sizing & pilot billing cadence
- proposed SLA/uptime targets for pilot phase

Ben Carter will be on the call to discuss dedicated pool economics and fallback pricing for the shared endpoint during pilot.

I'll send a calendar invite once Rachel confirms and include the Drive prework link.

Thanks,
